thread:
Ava Li: quick ping — PR #2567 needs one more approval before the Fri deploy window. It’s the tiny param-name tidy (ReqID -> RequestID) + a gofmt run. I fixed tests but CI is unhappy about formatting.
Samir Rao: on it, can you paste the failing file?
Ava Li: CI output: 
```
--- FAIL: fmt_check
./server/handler.go: line 312: gofmt: file is not gofmted with -s
```
Samir Rao: ahh, looks like the formatter changed a few short var names after the rename. I’ll run `gofumpt -w -extra` locally and push a follow-up commit. want me to squash?
Priya N: @Samir one small ask — keep the `RequestID` exported on the RPC struct, we depend on that casing in telemetry, otherwise LGTM.
Samir Rao: good catch. I’ll preserve the exported field.
Jun Park: fyi I scanned the PR and left a nit about a comment: `// req id for tracing` -> `// RequestID for tracing` (camel casing). small but consistent.
Ava Li: thanks Jun. That’s the only lingering nit from me. If Samir can update and rebase, we can merge in the next 2 hours.
ci-bot: Build #9842: fmt check failed — details at https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/9842 (gofmt diff attached) :x:
Samir Rao: pushed fix: `2567-fmt-reqid-squash` (new commit). Ran `gofumpt` and adjusted the comment.
Ava Li: pulled locally, tests pass. leaving final approval now. :thumbsup:
Priya N: approved. merging after green CI. :checkered_flag:
ci-bot: Build #9845: all checks passed ✅.
Ava Li: merged into main and scheduled for Friday 09:00 deploy window. thanks y’all — tiny but glad we caught the telemetry casing before rollout.
Jun Park: nice, thanks for handling the squash and quick followups.
Samir Rao: no prob — ping me if anything else pops from the opt-in flags.
Ava Li: added a short note in the PR about the telemetry dependency so future renames remember to check export/casing.
Priya N: thanks — that’ll save someone a 3am page :)
